Title: [LSJ] Rules Question(s): Canceling Votes and Multi-oust

Messages.Author: Totengräber
Messages.Body:
Question 1: I have Quentin and my prey has Gratiano. Quentin calls a
vote and sunsequently uses his special to cancel Gratiano's votes. My
prey then uses Surprise influence to add 2 votes. Are _all_ Gratiano's
votes canceled including votes gained after the cancel effect or does
he still get the two from Surprise Influence since it was played
_after_ his votes were canceled? Also, if Gratiano's votes, being the
only Priscus on the table, are canceled, does the subreferendum
abstain from voting?

Question 2: If multiple players would be ousted from a single effect
(i.e., Anarchist Uprising), who would get ousted first, who gains VP
and pool?

Example:
I have 6 pool
My Predator has 2 pool and 4 minions
My Grandpredator has 1 pool and 3 minions
I play Anarchist Uprising and the vote succeds.
Although in reality I didn't pull off AU, I figured it would go
simultaneously, but that didn't seem to make much sense that my
Grand-Grand-Predator would stand to gain a couple of VPs.

Thanks,
Todd Dunn
V:EKN Prince of Noblesville, IN

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Totengräber" <totengr...@yahoo.com> wrote in message
news:2743d22e.02042...@posting.google.com

> Question 1: I have Quentin and my prey has Gratiano. Quentin calls a
> vote and sunsequently uses his special to cancel Gratiano's votes. My
> prey then uses Surprise influence to add 2 votes. Are _all_ Gratiano's
> votes canceled including votes gained after the cancel effect or does
> he still get the two from Surprise Influence since it was played
> _after_ his votes were canceled?

All of his votes are cancelled.
[LSJ 2002-11-04]

http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3CB5AD3D.3798A6C7%40white-wolf.com

> Also, if Gratiano's votes, being the only Priscus on the table,
> are canceled, does the subreferendum abstain from voting?

Yes.
Online Rulebook, section 6.3.3
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/

> Question 2: If multiple players would be ousted from a single effect
> (i.e., Anarchist Uprising), who would get ousted first, who gains VP
> and pool?

They are all ousted at the same time. Only those Methuselahs still
in the game will gain pool, but all Methuselahs whose prey were ousted
will gain victory points.

See section 9.1 of the online rulebook, where this is
explicitly discussed.
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/

> Example:
> I have 6 pool
> My Predator has 2 pool and 4 minions
> My Grandpredator has 1 pool and 3 minions
> I play Anarchist Uprising and the vote succeds.
> Although in reality I didn't pull off AU, I figured it would go
> simultaneously, but that didn't seem to make much sense that my
> Grand-Grand-Predator would stand to gain a couple of VPs.

Your Grand-predator gains 1 victory point and is ousted.
Your Great-Grand-predator gains 1 victory point and 6 pool.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com
